project_scope: On-call professional services for various DREAM facility-related projects in Fulton County. Basic services include civil, mechanical, electrical, architectural, geotechnical, and structural engineering, as well as contract administration, prequalification, bidding support, and construction inspection. No specific building sizes, structural systems, spans, or gross floor areas are stated.
services: Standby architectural and engineering services including architecture, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, utility engineering, inspection services, contract administration, prequalification, bidding, construction inspection, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style standby services for a variety of unspecified projects, which reduces strategic relevance.
- Includes structural engineering among many disciplines, but no defined bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure component.
- Primarily general building/facility support rather than a clearly identifiable complex structural project.
- Multiple-award on-call contract with broad scope and limited technical specificity offers weak direct fit for sbp's specialist profile.
